label: It is possible that many of the words by which Jesus is reported to confide to the church the…
paraphrase: It is possible that many of the words by which Jesus is reported to confide to the church the right to bind and to unbind, to remit sins, to reprimand, to warn with authority and to pray with certainty of being heard (Matthew 18.17 and following; John 20.23) were attributed to him in order to warrant a collective authority that was afterward sought to be substituted for his. This states a possibility about many of the words; it does not say that all or any particular one of them was so attributed.
